paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Base LLaMA-3.1-8B & Mistral-7B-v0.3 in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: This pie chart visually represents a comparison of win rates between several large language models. The chart is divided into three segments, labeled GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral, and includes a legend indicating the percentage values for each. The segments are colored blue, gray, and red, respectively. The largest segment, colored blue, represents GPT-4o with a reported win rate of 96.8%.  The segment for GPT-4o is followed by LLaMA, shown in gray and representing 3.2% of the total, and lastly, Mistral, shown in red and representing 1.2% of the total. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The chart's segments are ordered by descending size, with GPT-4o taking up the majority of the pie, followed by LLaMA and then Mistral.
